_note: Link Hunt links. Edit freely: url, isReal, explanation_lo, explanation_en, redFlagPart (the exact piece of the url that gives a fake away; empty for real links). Keep about half real and half fake. Lao is a draft for native review.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ google.com ຄືສ່ວນກ່ອນເຄື່ອງໝາຍ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ. ເລີ່ມດ້ວຍ https ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຄຳແປກປອມ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is google.com, the part right before the first single “/”. It starts with https and has no extra words.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ facebook.com. ຄຳວ່າ “www” ເປັນພຽງຊື່ຍ່ອຍທົ່ວໄປທີ່ຢູ່ໜ້າໂດເມນ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is facebook.com. “www” is just a normal subdomain in front of it.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ youtube.com ສະກົດຖືກຕ້ອງ ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງຕໍ່ທ້າຍ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is youtube.com, spelled correctly, with nothing added after it.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. bcel.com.la ແມ່ນໂດເມນຂອງທະນາຄານເອງ ແລະ .com.la ເປັນຕົວຈົບຂອງທີ່ຢູ່ລາວ.
links.explanation_en: Real. bcel.com.la is the bank’s own domain, and .com.la is a Lao address ending.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ iom.int ຂອງອົງການສະຫະປະຊາຊາດດ້ານການຍ້າຍຖິ່ນ. “laopdr” ເປັນຊື່ຍ່ອຍຂອງລາວ ປອດໄພ ເພາະ iom.int ຢູ່ຖັດຈາກມັນ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is iom.int, the UN migration agency. “laopdr” is its Laos subdomain, which is safe because iom.int comes right after it.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ unicef.org. “/laos” ທີ່ຢູ່ຫຼັງມັນແມ່ນພຽງໜ້າໜຶ່ງພາຍໃນເວັບນັ້ນ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is unicef.org. The “/laos” after it is only a page inside that site.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ tiktok.com. ກວດສ່ວນກ່ອນເຄື່ອງໝາຍ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ ແລ້ວກົງກັນ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is tiktok.com. Check the part right before the first single “/”, and it matches.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. m.me ແມ່ນລິ້ງສັ້ນທາງການຂອງ Messenger ຈາກ Facebook. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ m.me ແລະ “/facebook” ແມ່ນຊື່ໜ້າ.
links.explanation_en: Real. m.me is Facebook’s official short link for Messenger. The domain is m.me, and “/facebook” is the page.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. who.int ແມ່ນອົງການອະນາໄມໂລກ. ໂດເມນຂອງເຂົາຈົບຫຼັງ “.int”.
links.explanation_en: Real. who.int is the World Health Organization. Its own domain ends right after “.int”.

links.explanation_lo: ຂອງແທ້. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ wikipedia.org. ເປັນ https ແລະ ບໍ່ມີຫຍັງເຊື່ອງຢູ່ລະຫວ່າງຊື່ ກັບ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ.
links.explanation_en: Real. The domain is wikipedia.org. It is https, and nothing is hidden between the name and the first “/”.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ນີ້ແມ່ນ g00gle.com ທີ່ໃຊ້ເລກສູນແທນຕົວ “o”. ຄົນຫຼອກລວງລອກຊື່ແທ້ ແຕ່ໃຊ້ຕົວອັກສອນທີ່ຄ້າຍກັນ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. This is g00gle.com with zeros instead of the letter “o”. Scammers copy a real name with look-alike characters.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ faceb00k-login.com: ໃຊ້ເລກສູນແທນ “o” ແລະ ເພີ່ມຄຳວ່າ “login”. ຂອງແທ້ແມ່ນ facebook.com.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The domain is faceb00k-login.com: zeros instead of “o”, and “login” added. The real one is facebook.com.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນຈິງແມ່ນ youtube-gift.xyz ບໍ່ແມ່ນ youtube.com. ຂອງແຖມຟຣີ ແລະ ຕົວຈົບ .xyz ເປັນສັນຍານເຕືອນ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The real domain is youtube-gift.xyz, not youtube.com. Free gifts and a .xyz ending are warning signs.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນແທ້ຂອງທະນາຄານແມ່ນ bcel.com.la. bcel-verify.net ເປັນເວັບອື່ນ ທີ່ພຽງແຕ່ເອົາຊື່ທະນາຄານມາໃຊ້.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The bank’s real domain is bcel.com.la. bcel-verify.net is a different site that only uses the bank’s name.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໃຫ້ອ່ານໂດເມນຈາກທ້າຍຊື່ ກ່ອນເຄື່ອງໝາຍ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ: ແມ່ນ secure-login.ru. “facebook.com” ເປັນພຽງກົນລວງດ້ວຍຊື່ຍ່ອຍ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. Read the domain from the end of the name, right before the first single “/”: it is secure-login.ru. “facebook.com” is only a subdomain trick.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ລິ້ງສັ້ນ bit.ly ເຊື່ອງປາຍທາງ, ສັນຍາວ່າໄດ້ລາງວັນ ແລະ ໃຊ້ http ແທນ https.
links.explanation_en: Fake. A shortened bit.ly link hides where it goes, it promises a prize, and it uses http instead of https.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. “ວີຊາຟຣີ” ແມ່ນສັນຍານອັນຕະລາຍ. ວີຊາແທ້ບໍ່ແມ່ນຟຣີ ແລະ ຕົວຈົບ .work ບໍ່ແມ່ນເວັບທາງການ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. “Free visa” is the red flag. Real visas are not free, and the .work ending is not an official site.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນຈິງແມ່ນ account-check.top ຄືສ່ວນກ່ອນເຄື່ອງໝາຍ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ. ຊື່ທະນາຄານເປັນພຽງຊື່ຍ່ອຍ ແລະ ລິ້ງເປັນ http ບໍ່ແມ່ນ https.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The real domain is account-check.top, the part right before the first single “/”. The bank’s name is only a subdomain, and the link is http, not https.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ tiktok-bonus.click ບໍ່ແມ່ນ tiktok.com. ເຫຼຽນຟຣີ ແລະ ໂບນັດ ເປັນເຫຍື່ອລໍ້ທີ່ພົບເລື້ອຍ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The domain is tiktok-bonus.click, not tiktok.com. Free coins and bonuses are a common bait.

links.explanation_lo: ປອມ. ໂດເມນຈິງແມ່ນ help-donate.cc. ເວັບແທ້ຂອງ UNICEF ແມ່ນ unicef.org ສະນັ້ນຊື່ອົງການທີ່ຢູ່ໜ້າບໍ່ໄດ້ພິສູດຫຍັງ.
links.explanation_en: Fake. The real domain is help-donate.cc. The real UNICEF site is unicef.org, so a charity name in front proves nothing.

_note_choice: choiceRounds: multiple-choice rounds mixed in with the Real/Fake links. kind 'which_real' = pick the real link; 'which_part' = pick the fake part of the url shown. answer is the index in options. Lao is a draft for native review.

choiceRounds.prompt_lo: ລິ້ງໃດແມ່ນເວັບທະນາຄານ BCEL ຂອງແທ້?
choiceRounds.prompt_en: Which link is the real BCEL bank site?
choiceRounds.explanation_lo: ອັນທຳອິດ. ໂດເມນແມ່ນ bcel.com.la ແທ້. ອັນອື່ນເພີ່ມຄຳ ຫຼື ປ່ຽນຕົວອັກສອນ (bce1 ໃຊ້ເລກ 1 ແທນ l) ຫຼື ເອົາ bcel.com.la ໄປໄວ້ໜ້າໂດເມນອື່ນ.
choiceRounds.explanation_en: The first one. Its domain really is bcel.com.la. The others add words, swap a letter (bce1 uses the number 1 for l) or hide bcel.com.la in front of a different domain.
choiceRounds.tip_lo: ອ່ານໂດເມນຈາກຂວາໄປຊ້າຍ ກ່ອນເຄື່ອງໝາຍ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ.
choiceRounds.tip_en: Read the domain from the right, up to the first single “/”.

choiceRounds.prompt_lo: ລິ້ງໃດເປັນຂອງ Facebook ແທ້?
choiceRounds.prompt_en: Which link really belongs to Facebook?
choiceRounds.explanation_lo: ອັນສຸດທ້າຍ. www.facebook.com ລົງທ້າຍດ້ວຍ facebook.com. ອັນອື່ນຖືກຕໍ່ທ້າຍດ້ວຍໂດເມນຂອງຄົນອື່ນ ຫຼື ໃຊ້ເລກ 0 ແທນຕົວ o.
choiceRounds.explanation_en: The last one. www.facebook.com ends in facebook.com. The others end in someone else's domain or use zeros instead of the letter o.
choiceRounds.tip_lo: ຊື່ແທ້ຢູ່ທ້າຍໂດເມນ, ບໍ່ແມ່ນຕົ້ນ.
choiceRounds.tip_en: The real name sits at the end of the domain, not the start.

choiceRounds.prompt_lo: ສ່ວນໃດຂອງລິ້ງນີ້ທີ່ເປັນຕົວປອມ?
choiceRounds.prompt_en: Which part of this link is the fake?
choiceRounds.explanation_lo: ໂດເມນຈິງແມ່ນ verify-login.net ເພາະຢູ່ກ່ອນ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ. bcel.com.la ເປັນພຽງຊື່ຍ່ອຍທີ່ໃຊ້ຫຼອກຕາ.
choiceRounds.explanation_en: The real domain is verify-login.net because it comes just before the first “/”. bcel.com.la is only a subdomain used to fool you.
choiceRounds.tip_lo: ເບິ່ງສິ່ງທີ່ຢູ່ຕິດກັບ “/” ອັນທຳອິດ.
choiceRounds.tip_en: Look at what sits next to the first “/”.

choiceRounds.prompt_lo: ສ່ວນໃດຂອງລິ້ງນີ້ທີ່ເປັນຕົວປອມ?
choiceRounds.prompt_en: Which part of this link is the fake?
choiceRounds.explanation_lo: ໂດເມນຈິງແມ່ນ account-check.xyz. ຄຳວ່າ login.facebook.com ແມ່ນພຽງຊື່ຍ່ອຍຂອງໂດເມນນັ້ນ.
choiceRounds.explanation_en: The real domain is account-check.xyz. login.facebook.com is only a subdomain of it.
choiceRounds.tip_lo: ຊື່ຍ່ອຍຕັ້ງໄດ້ຕາມໃຈ, ໂດເມນຕ້ອງຊື້.
choiceRounds.tip_en: Anyone can pick a subdomain; a domain has to be bought.
